Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is all we have from this match. The second match of the series will be played on the same ground on the 18th of February. That match will begin at 7 pm IST (1.30 pm GMT). India have a 1-0 lead and will be looking to seal the series. Whereas West Indies will be looking to bounce back and take it to a decider. Do join us then. Goodbye and take care!

Ravi Bishnoi wins the Man of the Match award for his exceptional spell with the ball on debut. He says, his nerves have settled in by now. Mentions, he is really happy to represent India in the T20I format. Adds, he was just aiming to bowl stump to stump but he erred in lines several times and would hope to improve the same in the next game. Adds, he hasn’t played a game with dew on the ball. Adds it is a dream come true to win the Player of the Match on debut.

Rohit Sharma, the Indian captain says that they should have finished it off sooner but trying to do things a bit different didn't work out well. He adds that the bowlers were brilliant to restrict such a good batting side to a modest total and admits that they were not clinical enough with the bat. He mentions that Ravi Bishnoi is a real talent and that is why he has been drafted into the side and can bowl anywhere, this also helps to rotate the bowlers. He also mentions that someone like Shreyas Iyer is sitting out which is a bit hard on him but Venkatesh Iyer just gives them the extra option with the ball at the moment. He also mentions that all the guys are great professionals and they understand that they need to remain patient for their opportunities and the coaching staff is clear enough to tell them that the ones who are in form will get a run of games in order to maintain that momentum. About Kishan, he says that it's their job to make sure that they do not put too much pressure on his shoulders.

West Indies skipper, Kieron Pollard says, it was a good game of cricket. To take the game down to the 19th over that feels good. Adds, they were like 20 to 30 runs short and were hurt majorly in the Powerplay. Adds, they need to play well as they progress. Adds, they will continue to work on the errors. Says, he wants his bowlers to be fresh and hopefully have a good impact on the next game.
Time for the Presentation...

Suryakumar Yadav is up for a quick chat. He says looking at the dew, he had a chat with Pant in the dugout and noticed the ball is running faster when hit squarer of the wicket. Adds, he asked Iyer to play good shots and have intent and is really happy with the way he played. Says he thinks the opposition spinners bowled really well but later due to the dew they were unable to get grip off the surface.

West Indies seemed to be 20 runs or so short to begin with and with the dew coming into play, it was always going to be a tough ask for their bowlers. This was true, at least for the Powerplay as the pacers were hammered all around the park by Rohit Sharma. The first over of spin from Akeal Hosein too proved to be expensive but then Roston Chase came on and he picked up the Indian skipper. After that, both spinners bowled in tandem and kept on stemming the flow of runs. Kishan and Kohli too fell to the spinners and the Windies started to believe. This belief was shattered as Suryakumar Yadav hit the boundaries at the right times for the opposition and ended Windies hopes. They will now look to put on a better batting performance in the next match and will look to better their death bowling as well.

After that early blitz from Rohit Sharma, India looked to be chasing the target down with overs to spare. It was not the case though as after Sharma fell, things got slowed down. Ishan Kishan did make 35 runs but they came at a struggle and he failed to build on it. Kohli was dismissed shortly after Kishan and suddenly the required rate was rising up. Suryakumar Yadav though remained fairly calm and along with the inexperienced Venkatesh Iyer, made sure that the scoreboard kept ticking over and the bad balls were sent to the fence. This 48-run stand was the difference and India won the contest with 7 balls to spare.

India looked to be in a bit of jeopardy but have managed to get over the line in the end and go 1-0 up in the three-match series thanks to a brilliant partnership between Suryakumar Yadav and Venkatesh Iyer. A top effort from the West Indies bowlers but in the end, they go home empty-handed yet again.

SIX! GAME OVER! Suryakumar Yadav wins the game in style for his team. Tossed up, full and on off. Iyer gets under it and smokes it over the long on fence. No chance for the fielder in the deep. INDIA WIN THE GAME BY 6 wickets.
Fuller, on middle and league. Suryakumar Yadav flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Suryakumar Yadav has ice in his veins. Tossed up, full and wide outside off. Suryakumar Yadav uses his hands really well and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Iyer comes down the track and eases it to long on for a run.
Angled in , on middle. Yadav makes room and drives it through the cover region for a single.
Fabian Allen (1-0-10-0) to bowl the penultimate over. Just 9 needed now off 12 balls. Can Allen do something spectacular here?
FOUR! Iyer looks to be in a hurry now. Full toss and on off. Iyer stands tall and hits it over the bowler's head for a boundary at long on. India inching closer to the finish line.
Suryakumar Yadav gets hit on the helmet and the umpire signals for the physio to come out for a mandatory concussion chacek. SKY seems fine and play will continue.
A full-toss on the bodyline. Suryakumar Yadav looks to heave it across the line but misses. It flies to the off side off the back of the blade. They take one.
Back of a length, outside off. Iyer looks to heave it away but inside-edges it towards fine leg. They take one.
Good running! A full-length ball, outside off. Iyer drives it through covers. The fielder in the deep does well to stop the boundary. Two taken.
Good length, outside off. Suryakumar Yadav shuffles across and works it through mid-wicket for one.
Full length, on leg. Iyer flicks it over mid on for a single.
SIX! BANG! This is the over that India were after. Back of a length, on top of leg. Suryakumar Yadav gets inside the line and muscles it over the fine leg fence for a biggie. 13 runs off the over.
FOUR! CRISP! A full-length ball, wide outside off. Yadav goes after it and slashes it through the cover region for a boundary.
Oh just short! A length ball, angling down leg. Iyer waits for the ball and tries to paddle it over short fine leg fielder but fails to middle it. They take one.
Romario Shepherd steams in with a length ball, on middle and leg. Yadav stays back and flicks it to mid-wicket for one run.
A length ball, on the pads. Iyer nudges it to deep square leg for a single.
Swing and a miss! Back of a length, outside off. Iyer advances down the track and looks to heave it away but misses.
A length ball, on middle. Iyer tucks it to mid-wicket. They take a single. It's been 10 balls since the last boundary.
WIDE! West Indies cannot bowl extras at this moment. It is fuller and wide outside off. Iyer does not go after it. Wide called.
A length ball, on middle and leg. Yadav pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one run.
Another single now! Fuller, sliding down leg. Iyer clips it to fine leg for one. 35 needed of 26 balls. Still a good equation for India.
A full-length ball, outside off. Yadav wrists it down to long on for a single.
WIDE! Back of a length, just outside the tramline. Yadav tries to reach out but fails. Wide called.
Two dots in a row! A length ball, on middle. Yadav looks to heave it across the line but misses to get hit high on the pads. Pooran appeals from behind the stumps but the bowler shows no interest.
A length ball, on off. Suryakumar Yadav pushes it to cover.
Shorter and slower, around middle. Suryakumar Yadav pulls it down to deep square leg for another single. India need 38 runs to win off 30 balls.
Fuller in length, Iyer flicks it through square leg for a single.
FOUR! A length ball, down the leg side. Venkatesh Iyer flicks it away fine and the ball runs away into the fine leg fence.
Venkatesh Iyer comes in at number 6.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rishabh Pant is livid with himself and he should be! Banged into the deck, slower and on the body. Pant swivels back and looks to lift it over short fine leg but there's no pace on the ball to work with. Pant ends up getting it off the top edge and the ball loops up towards short fine leg. Odean Smith takes a dolly and out comes the 'salute send-off' from Sheldon Cottrell. 44 required off 33 balls. Can the Windies pull off the unthinkable?
Commentary.Howout: c Odean Smith b Sheldon Cottrell

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, slower and around off. Pant uses his wrists to pull it finer. He doesn't get it fine enough and it will just be a couple.

Right back at the bowler! Fullish delivery, on middle. Rishabh Pant skips down the track and hammers it right back at the bowler. Sheldon Cottrell cannot get his body out of the way and makes a good stop at the expense of getting a body blow though.
A dot to end! A full toss, on off. Yadav drives it straight to the fielder at extra cover.

FOUR! Suryakumar Yadav is a master of that shot. Slower one, banged in around off. SKY makes just a bit of room and waits for it patiently. He then just ramps it over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Almost yorker length, around off. Pant digs it out towards extra cover for a quick single.
Excellent delivery! Very full and very wide. Pant leaves it alone but the umpire deems it's just inside the tramline.
Two more! On the body, Pant just dabs it down towards the vacant mid-wicket region and races back for the second.

Shorter in length, a bit slower and angled at the body. Pant with a short-arm jab towards square leg. The fielder over there does well to get low to his right and make a half stop. The batters get a couple.
Change. Odean Smith (1-0-22-0) is back into the attack now.
On off. Yadav defends it out. 55 runs required now off 42 balls.
FOUR! Now on the other side. On middle and leg, Suryakumar Yadav flicks it past short fine leg and picks up another boundary. With that, the 100 comes up for India as well.

FOUR! Positive intent is shown right from the off by Suryakumar Yadav. Quicker and shorter, outside off. SKY rocks back and cuts it hard behind point. The fielder from deep point runs around and puts in the dive but it goes in vain. A boundary for SKY.
Suryakumar Yadav is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! This game has turned on its head in a space of four deliveries! Nicely flighted, around off. Virat Kohli uses his feet to get to the pitch of the ball but doesn't go through with the shot. He just tries to caress the ball and ends up lifting it straight towards the man at the long off fence. Kieron Pollard takes the simplest of catches and Fabian Allen has done the trick for his team. Two set batters dismissed and West Indies will now believe.
Commentary.Howout: c Kieron Pollard b Fabian Allen

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, on middle. This is driven through mid on for one more.
Looks for two but it will only be a single. On off, this is pushed down to long off for a run.
Rishabh Pant comes in at number 4. India need 65 runs off 48 balls. They still have ample batting to come and have the power-hitters to chase this down.

OUT! TAKEN! 'Catch it' is the call and Roston Chase winds up a brilliant spell with his second wicket of the night. Chase angles it on a length and into leg side. Ishan Kishan gets cramped for room and hence looks to use the depth of the crease to muscle it across. Kishan pulls it flat and the ball goes straight down the throat of the fielder at the mid-wicket fence. Fabian Allen, one of the best fielders in the world isn't going to drop that one. Ishan Kishan's troubled stay at the crease comes to an end. 65 still needed off 48 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Fabian Allen b Roston Chase

Commentary.Commentary: On middle and leg, Kohli dabs it 'round the corner to rotate the strike.
Quicker and fuller, around off and at 107 kph. Kishan drills it down to long off for just a single.
Kohli makes room and Chase follows him down the leg side. Kohli brooms it towards deep backward square leg for a run.
On off, this is nicely driven through mid on for a single.
Loopy delivery, very full and this one ends up being a yorker around the off pole. Ishan Kishan looks to jam it out on the off side but misses.
On middle. This is pulled down to deep mid-wicket for one more.
Flatter and sliding into leg. Kohli backs away and looks to flick it leg side. The ball gets the inside edge and goes off the pads onto the off side. They sneak in a quick run.
Slowed up and angled into middle and leg. Kishan seems to be winding up for the big shot but has to adjust and just eases it down to wide long on for a run.
Quicker and shorter, on off. Kohli rocks back and cuts it to sweeper cover for one.
FOUR! Lovely use of the feet from Virat Kohli. On a length, around off. Kohli steps down the track and hits it straight, over the bowler's head and for a boundary.
The early call is for two but it will only be a single. Kishan makes room leg side and Hosein follows him. Kishan works it towards deep mid-wicket for just a single.

DRINKS! The required run rate was a shade under 8 rpo and has remained almost the same. Rohit Sharma was deadly at the start and took on the pacers. Since his wicket though, the spinners have put a hold on to the free-flowing Indian innings. Ishan Kishan has remained at the crease but hasn't looked at his best. Along with Kohli, Kishan will be looking to put on a stand that puts his side in the driver's seat. Roston Chase has been exceptional but the spinners have just two overs left and the Windies need their pacers to fire now if they are to win this game.
On off, Kishan pushes it into covers for a single. 7 runs off it. A good over for India.
CLOSE! Short ball, outside off. Kishan stays on the back foot and looks to cut it away but misses.
FOUR! Nicely played. A much-needed boundary for India. Tossed up, full and outside off. Kishan reaches out and slashes it through covers for a boundary.
Looped up, full and on off. Kohli eases it to long on for a single.
Short and outside off. Kishan cuts it to point. One run.
A huge mix-up! Angled into the pads. Kishan gets it to the off side. There was lack of communication and lot of confusion for the single. In the end the throw was late and both the batters were safe.
Fuller, sliding down leg. Kishan whips it through mid-wicket for a single. The spinners have done well to pull things back for the visitors.
On a length, sliding into the pads. Kohli pushes it to long on for a run.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Kohli flicks it through mid-wicket for two runs.
LEG BYE! Quicker and flatter, on the pads. Kishan looks to heave it across the line but misses. The ball rolls to fine leg off the pads. They collect a leg bye.
Tossed up, on off. Kohli eases it to cover for a single.
Fuller, on the pads, Kohli clips it through mid-wicket. The batters push hard for two and get two.
A really good over by Chase comes to an end. A short ball, on leg. Kishan fails to deal with it and get hit on the pads.
Touch short, around off. Kishan cuts it towards backward point.
Short and on off. Kohli flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Virat Kohli walks in at number 3 for India.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rohit Sharma tries to get going yet again but could not clear the man in the deep. India lose their first wicket. Floated, full and on off. Rohit Sharma gets low and slog-sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket. The ball goes miles up in the air. Odean Smith keeps his eyes on the ball and takes a sharp catch near the ropes.
Commentary.Howout: c Odean Smith b Roston Chase

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, outside off. Kishan drives it through covers for a single.
Short and outside off. Kishan pushes it towards extra cover.
Another single as this is worked through mid-wicket. Just 5 runs come off the over.
Fuller, on off. Sharma drills it down to long on for a single.
On middle and leg, Kishan clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Looped up, full and on off. Kishan sweeps it to the leg side.
Flatter and short, outside off. Sharma punches it through the cover region for another single.
Angled into the pads. Kishan flicks it to square leg for a single.
Flighted, full and on off. Sharma gets and inside edge to fine leg. A beautiful delivery to end the over. Just a single off it. India are at 58/0 at the end of Powerplay.
Floated, full and on the pads. Kishan clips it to mid-wicket for a quick single.
Full, on middle and leg. Played back to the bowler.
Make that three! These dots are coming in the final over of the Powerplay. This has done the trick for the visitors. Floated, full and down leg. Kishan sweeps it to short fine leg.
Two dots in a row! Swing and a miss this time! Tossed up, outside off. Some extra bounce on offer. Kishan gets low and looks to cut it away but misses.
Looped up, full and on off. Kishan pushes it to point with soft hands.
Roston Chase comes into the attack now.

FOUR! The boundaries just keep on coming! Drifted onto the pads, Sharma sweeps hard and gets it over backward square leg. The ball runs away into the vacant fence and 13 runs come off that over. 101 more required off 90 balls now.
Quicker one, on off. Sharma defends it under the eyeline.
darted into middle and leg. This is turned through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! The fifty partnership is up between these two in little to no time. Flatter delivery, sliding down leg. Kishan goes deep in his crease and tickles it past short fine leg for back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Easily done! On a length, turning in from around off. Ishan Kishan gets in position early and sweeps it behind square for a boundary.
On off. Kishan leans in to defend.
Akeal Hosein comes into the attack.

SIX! Fourth boundary in the over and 22 runs come off it! Short again, this time it's not that high. Rohit Sharma pulls it with ease and the ball flies over the square leg fence. West Indies need wickets now or else they could be in big trouble.
FOUR! The boundaries are coming at a hemmoraghing rate now. Not quite a half-volley but Sharma hits through the line and beats the man at mid off to collect another boundary.
Looks like the ball is lost. There is some delay due to it. The ball is back and the game continues.

SIX! Rohit Sharma loves the pull shot and he loves this ground. Well-directed bouncer from Odean Smith. Around off and at helmet height. Sharma looks for the pull but the ball flies off the top edge and goes over the keeper's head and clears the fence as well.
Smith hits the length hard and angles it into the hips from 'round the stumps. Kishan jabs it towards mid-wicket for one more.
On a good length, angled into off. Sharma hops and jams it out towards cover for a single.
FOUR! Exceptional timing but the outfield is just lightning quick. Full and straight. Rohit Sharma with a gentle push through mid-wicket and the ball runs away into the fence.

FOUR! Well watched and well played. Good-length ball, a bit wide of off and shaping away. Ishan Kishan stays on the back foot and just taps it through the gap at cover-point for another boundary. 11 off the over, a good one for India.
Around the hips, Sharma tucks it 'round the corner for a single.
WIDE! Another short ball, down the leg side. Wided.

FOUR! Change of pace from Cottrell and Rohit Sharma picks it up nicely. Shorter and slower, around leg. Sharma pulls it behind square on the leg side. Fabian Allen runs to his right and the ball just shoots off the surface and goes through his hands for a boundary.
On a good length, around off. Kishan hangs back and steers it down to third man for a single.
Lovely bowling! A length ball, angled into off but nips away sharply after pitching. Kishan looks to cut it late but the ball zips past the outside edge.
Full, on off and shaping away. Ishan Kishan with a classy-looking drive straight to point.

SIX! Now that is pure timing! Shepherd just drifts onto the pads and Rohit Sharma whips it off his legs. He launches it high and handsome over the square leg fence for the first maximum of the innings.
No timing! On middle and leg. Sharma dances down the track and mistimes it straight towards mid on.
Fuller delivery, angled into middle but shapes away nicely. Rohit Sharma squeezes it out towards cover.
On the pads and Kishan will feel he missed out on that one. He looks to flick it away but gets an inside edge to short fine leg for a single.
This is angled into middle and leg. Sharma sort of half-punches it towards silly mid on for a quick single.
A length ball, on that fourth stump line. Sharma stays solid in defense.
Romario Shepherd to steam in from the other end.
Well bowled again! Just short of a length, closer to the off pole and once again the ball nips away late. Kishan tries to steer it behind square but is well beaten Just 3 off the first over.
Back of a length, around off. Ishan Kishan is off the mark with the back foot punch towards deep backward point.
Good delivery. Back of a length, around off and this one moves away late off the surface. Kishan is deceived but manages to keep it out on the off side.
Cottrell hits the length hard and bowls it on off. Kishan looks to pull it away but gets a bottom edge back onto the deck.
Good-length ball, on the pads. Kishan flicks it straight to the man at short 45.
A bit of swing straightaway but Rohit Sharma is underway. On middle and swinging back in. Sharma clips it down to deep square leg for a single.
